headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI Integration
summary: By integrating AI features, CodeClip can offer smarter code suggestions and categorization, improving user experience and efficiency. Additionally, incorporating a clean interface inspired by Gathin23/cleanyourtv will make the app more visually appealing.
actions: Integrate an AI-powered code suggestion feature similar to DeepInfer from deepseek-ai/DeepInfer to enhance snippet organization and sharing.
Adopt a minimalist design approach, drawing inspiration from Gathin23/cleanyourtv, to improve the overall user interface of CodeClip.
Implement smart categorization algorithms that can automatically sort code snippets based on their content and context, inspired by the REA-Prompts project from
